t: Titan TTB1347SDM 220-240V SDS Max rotary hammer drill delivers high-performance drilling and chiselling in heavy-duty demolition and masonry work. The powerful 1450W corded tool is designed for demolition contractors and builders tackling tough masonry tasks. High impact energy of 12J ensures rapid material removal, while a magnesium gearbox provides durable heat dissipation. A 4-in-1 mode knob allows quick switching between functions, and an 8-position chisel rotation system enhances user safety and versatility across a range of applications. Also equipped with safety clutch protection to prevent kickback if the bit binds, and an anti-vibration system for reduced user fatigue during prolonged operation. 6 variable speed settings offer precise control across different materials. Supplied with 3 drill bits, 2 chisels, depth gauge, dust cap and carry case.
